private_note: I cannot know my group or even estimate odds, and the choice binds for a generation with no do-over. So I judge each plan by how bad my worst case could be. Hazel's floor (41) is the highest; Birch (36) and Alder (32) next. Cedar's floor of 15 is worse than today's 22, so I'd rather the convention fail. I will move toward Alder or Birch if Hazel can't reach nine, since any floor-raising plan beats Today.
statement: Fellow delegates, none of us knows where we will land, and none of us can even guess the odds. The delegates weren't chosen at random. Whatever we pick lasts a generation and can't be revisited. When stakes are that high and that uncertain, I think the sensible thing is to ask what happens to each of us if we end up at the bottom. Hazel gives the lowest group 41, almost double today's 22, and no plan does better for that group. Under Cedar we could fall to 15 with no safety net. That is a gamble on a lifetime with no way to hedge it. My ranking is Hazel, then Birch, then Alder. All three protect us far better than Today does, and I would rather the convention fail than adopt Cedar. We need nine votes, so let us find the strongest floor most of us can accept.
